up: Return the first 500 compounds (by ChEMBL ID) that have a Kd measurement below 100 nM against a human single-protein target. For each compound, include its canonical SMILES and ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH target_hits AS ( SELECT DISTINCT a.molregno FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_type = 'Kd' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_value < 100 AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' ORDER BY a.molregno ASC LIMIT 500 ) SELECT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM target_hits th JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON th.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
